The schema definition is hardcoded here in the retry prompt. This creates a maintenance hazard because any changes to `MeechieStudioTextOutputSchema` or `STUDIO_TEXT_RESPONSE_FORMAT` must be manually synchronized here. Consider deriving these field names and types from a shared constant or programmatically from the schema to ensure the model always receives accurate guidance.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The call to `MeechieStudioTextResultSchema.safeParse(result)` is redundant. The `parseProviderText` function already validates the output against the schema and returns a structured `MeechieStudioTextResult`. Since `result` is already typed and guaranteed to be valid by the internal logic of `parseProviderText`, this additional validation step can be removed to improve performance and simplify the code.

`buildRetryMessage` describes `rating` and `revisionNote` as optional, but the pipeline is simultaneously sending a strict `responseFormat` JSON schema where those fields are listed as required (STUDIO_TEXT_RESPONSE_FORMAT.required includes `rating` and `revisionNote`). This creates conflicting instructions to the model and can cause the provider’s schema enforcement to reject the retry output (e.g., if the model omits those keys), leading to avoidable 4xx/502 failures.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restrict 504 mapping to actual timeout failures**

`classifyProviderError` now maps every `PROVIDER_NETWORK_ERROR` to HTTP 504, but the provider adapter emits that same code for all thrown transport failures (timeouts and non-timeouts like DNS/TLS/socket errors) and only differentiates via the message (`isAbortError(...)` in `src/lib/adapters/provider-adapter.adapter.ts`). This means non-timeout outages are now mislabeled as gateway timeouts, which can drive incorrect retry/backoff behavior in callers that treat 504 specially.

_🛠️ Refactor suggestion_ | _🟠 Major_ | _🏗️ Heavy lift_

**Move runtime-mode checks out of the pipeline.**

Line 161 introduces direct process-env access inside a `src/lib/core/*-pipeline.ts` file. That breaks the seam boundary and makes this branch depend on ambient process state instead of injected orchestration inputs. Pass the runtime mode through pipeline deps/config from a seam instead of reading `env` here. As per coding guidelines, `src/**/*.ts`: "All filesystem/network/process I/O must flow through approved seam adapters only; no helper I/O" and `src/lib/core/*-pipeline.ts`: "Request path orchestration in src/lib/core/<feature>-pipeline.ts must be pure orchestration with no direct I/O".

```
In `@src/lib/core/meechie-studio-text-pipeline.ts` around lines 154 - 163, The
classifyProviderError function currently reads env.NODE_ENV directly; change it
to be pure by adding a runtimeMode (or isProduction boolean) parameter to
classifyProviderError and use that param to decide the returned status instead
of env.NODE_ENV; update all callers in the pipeline to pass the runtime mode
from the pipeline deps/config seam (the orchestration entrypoint that has access
to process env), and remove any direct process.env access from
src/lib/core/meechie-studio-text-pipeline.ts so all runtime I/O flows through
the injected seam.
```

</details>

_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Preserve valid JSON primitives so they classify as schema failures, not parse failures.**

Line 301/302 still collapses valid JSON like `false`, `0`, `""`, and `null` into `json_error` because the extraction path uses falsy/null sentinels. That means this new retry flow can emit the generic “valid JSON” prompt even when parsing already succeeded. Use an explicit parse result/sentinel from `extractJson`/`parseJsonCandidate` so valid-but-wrong-shape payloads reach Zod and become `schema_error`.

**Keep the retry prompt consistent with the enforced response schema.**

Lines 341-345 tell the model that `rating` and `revisionNote` are optional, but this same request still sends `STUDIO_TEXT_RESPONSE_FORMAT` with both fields in `required` on Lines 49-57, and Line 107 says they are required too. That contradiction makes the single retry less reliable on the exact recovery path this change is trying to improve.

<details>
<summary>🔧 Minimal fix</summary>

```diff
 	return [
 		`Your previous response was valid JSON but failed schema validation: ${schemaHint}.`,
 		'Respond with ONLY a JSON object with these required fields:',
 		'verdict (string), quote (string), pageTitle (string),',
 		'pageItems (array of 2-6 objects each with integer "number" and string "label"),',
-		'qualityState ("ready" | "needs_more_evidence" | "blocked").',
-		'Optional: rating (integer 1-10), revisionNote (string).',
+		'qualityState ("ready" | "needs_more_evidence" | "blocked"),',
+		'rating (integer 1-10), revisionNote (string).',
 		'No markdown fences, no prose, no code blocks.'
 	].join(' ');
```
</details>
